newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money market rates ease after ultimo spike.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money market rates ease after ultimo spike.

text.p: Swiss money market rates eased to slightly above 1.5 percent from 3.00 to 3-1/2 percent on Wednesday as banks had wrapped demand for liquidity ahead of the month and quarter end, dealers said.
"We are again back to normal levels," said one dealer.
Tomorrow/next was quoted at 1-3/4 to 1-7/8 percent in the market.
The Swiss National Bank (SNB) was also in the market this morning, offering tomorrow/next at 1-3/4 percent, dealers said.
